name_ar: مهرجان الربيع 2023 (وداع النمر وربيع الأرانب والتنين)
name_en: Spring Festival 2023 (Tiger Farewell, Bunny Spring, Poised Dragon)

schedule._note: [FestivalYears 2026-10-14] SpringFestival: only the newest official edition (SpringFestival2026) runs on its yearly dates, like the official server; this older edition runs only with @festival on LunarNewYear2023. Old yearly schedule kept in _schedule_yearly.

announce_ar: بدأ مهرجان الربيع! كلّم GiltSwirl في توين سيتي (387,382) عشان تودّع النمر وتزيّن قرية الأرانب وتساعد التنين الذهبي.
announce_en: The Spring Festival has started! Talk to GiltSwirl in Twin City (387,382): bid the Tiger King farewell, decorate Bunny Village and help the Gold Dragon King fly.
end_ar: انتهى مهرجان الربيع. نشوفكم السنة الجاية!
end_en: The Spring Festival has ended. See you next year!
notes: Agent 4 (2026-10-13). Official Questinfo festival quests 5442-5446 (Tiger Farewell), 5447-5449 (Bunny Spring), 5450-5452 (Poised Dragon), official dates 2023-01-17..2023-01-30. Official instances 1002210/1002211/1002212(/1002213) have no client doc; the client GameMap.dat registers the 2023 Spring block 12019 (2023tsf_new), 12021 (woods), 12022 (mfpk), 12023 (warrior_new), 12024 (tiger01) and every official quest point is walkable on exactly those docs -> the festival uses 12021/12022/12023 directly as shared event maps (no instance needed: nobody else uses them). Rewards: Questinfo gives none for these 11 quests, so the festival pays none (only the server's normal per-quest EXP ball under level 130). See README_AR.md.
